title: Why Multitasking Actually Makes You Slower
hook: Do you often feel less productive when juggling multiple tasks?

narration.text: Your brain can only truly focus on one complex task at a time.
What feels like multitasking is actually rapid task-switching.
Each switch incurs a 'cost' as your brain reorients itself.
This cognitive load slows you down and increases errors.
It takes time to regain deep focus on the original task.
Think of it like repeatedly stopping and starting a car on a journey.
You use more fuel and the journey takes much longer.
Have you noticed this mental fatigue when you try to multitask?

description: It feels like we are getting more done when we multitask, but the science shows the opposite is true. Discover why your brain is actually less efficient when trying to juggle multiple tasks simultaneously.
topic: Why multitasking is often less efficient than focusing on one task.
